latent_metadata.prompt: A person waving one hand, plain background, static camera.

interval: decode_latent including VAE load, GPU transfers, and float32 CPU output; excluding MP4 encoding
peak_semantics: absolute process allocator peaks, not whole-card nvidia-smi or deltas
limitations: Single fresh-process diagnostic, not full-generation speed or quality acceptance; instrumented memory-history/hook diagnostic
video_validation: nonempty file and hash only; full MP4 decode verification pending
